output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Alphabet's latest earnings are for Q3 2026, the quarter ended September 30, reported on October 28. Revenue rose 25% year over year to $127.6 billion, while net income available to common stockholders was $26.2 billion and EPS was $2.12. Operating income increased 30% year over year, with an operating margin of 31.8%. Google Cloud revenue increased 103% year over year to $30.7 billion.
